title: Two `chat work` processes on one computer fail each other: "another process holds the task store lock"
body:
Dogfooding 2026-10-02: with two `openagents chat work --issues …` batches running on one Mac, #10178 failed with "The fix turn could not start: another process holds the task store lock; retry after it exits" and #10179 with "Coder's task could not be read: another process holds the task store lock". Nothing was wrong with either change.

Fix: task store lock acquisition waits (with backoff, bounded only by the lock holder exiting or releasing, logging once) instead of failing the flow; reads that only need a snapshot don't take the exclusive lock at all. Find the lock in `crates/coder/src/task/` (store/owner). Tests: two processes contending — both flows proceed.
